claims.text: The FDA adalimumab label says patients taking concomitant immunosuppressants such as corticosteroids may have greater infection risk; betamethasone belongs to this class.
claims.quote: Patients 65 years of age and older, patients with co-morbid conditions and/or patients taking concomitant immunosuppressants (such as corticosteroids or methotrexate), may be at greater risk of infection.

headline.text: The FDA adalimumab label flags greater infection risk with concomitant corticosteroids, the class containing betamethasone.

reported.text: The warning addresses corticosteroids as a class and does not name betamethasone individually.

gaps.text: The packet contains no study specifically evaluating adalimumab with betamethasone.
